title: Annual report; electric utility company
bodyText: . Each electric utility company shall track and report to the public utilities commission, on an annual basis, data and trends regarding customer retention or attrition at a time and in a manner as prescribed by the commission.
bodyHtml: [§269-97]  Annual report; electric utility company.  Each electric utility company shall track and report to the public utilities commission, on an annual basis, data and trends regarding customer retention or attrition at a time and in a manner as prescribed by the commission. [L 2022, c 240, §2]
